example_text: Rs.2,500.00 debited from A/c XX1234 on 12-Aug-26 to VPA merchant@okaxis. UPI Ref No 123456789012. If not done by you, call 1800-425-3800.
why_legit: Contains no links to click, references specific masked account numbers and official UPI reference IDs, and directs users to a legitimate toll-free helpline instead of demanding immediate chat interaction.
source_citation: NPCI / RBI Compliant Bank Transaction Notification Standard

example_text: Your Amazon order #402-1234567 is out for delivery and will arrive today by 8 PM. Track securely at amazon.in/orders
why_legit: Links strictly to the verified official domain (amazon.in), requests zero delivery fees, contains no threat language, and references an authentic tracking identifier.

example_text: 123456 is your OTP for login to SBI NetBanking. Valid for 10 minutes. Do not share this OTP with anyone including bank staff.
why_legit: Includes the mandatory RBI-mandated security disclaimer ('Do not share this OTP with anyone including bank staff'), contains no payment request links, and uses a strict numeric verification token.
source_citation: RBI Master Circular on Electronic Banking Security

example_text: Hi candidate, this is HR from TechCorp India. Thank you for applying for the Software Engineer role. We would like to schedule your technical interview on Monday at 3 PM via Google Meet. Please confirm your availability.
why_legit: Demands no upfront registration fees or deposits, references a formal corporate identity, and utilizes standardized mainstream platforms (Google Meet) without artificial time pressure.

example_text: Reminder: Please complete your periodic KYC update by visiting your nearest HDFC Bank branch or logging into the official HDFC MobileBanking app before 30-Sep-2026.
why_legit: Directs users securely to physical branches or the official application instead of providing an external phishing link, allowing a reasonable multi-week window without account suspension threats.

example_text: Your electricity bill for consumer ID 9876543210 for August 2026 amounting to Rs.1,450.00 is generated. View and pay securely via the official portal at msedcl.in.
why_legit: Lists exact consumer billing details, specifies an official state government or utility domain (`.in`), and avoids emergency disconnection threats via unverified links.
source_citation: State Power Distribution Board Billing Standard

example_text: Dear Taxpayer, your Income Tax Return for Assessment Year 2026-27 has been successfully processed. Refund of Rs.4,200 has been issued to your validated bank account. Check details at incometax.gov.in
source_citation: Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) E-Filing Standard
why_legit: Directs strictly to the official government portal (`.in` / `.gov.in`) without asking for sensitive PINs, credentials, or advance processing charges.

example_text: Your recharge of Rs.299 for mobile number XXXXXX1234 is successful. Pack validity: 28 days. Enjoy unlimited calls and 1.5GB/day data. Thank you for choosing Jio.
why_legit: Confirms a user-initiated action completed inside an official carrier app, containing zero external action triggers or payment demands.
